title: 16x16 pillow forms
text: 16x16 pillow forms. I purchased some very expensive pillow shams for my 16x16 pillows.  My pillows couldn't be stuffed into the shams because they were too fat - the opening on the shams was horribly too small.  So I purchased these in hopes of being able to fold them and get them into the expensive shams.  Worked perfectly.  I will say they are not super fluffy... so I put another fluffier pillow (also they were smaller 12x12)  to add a little more body because the expensive shams were less than perfect... and that worked.  These pillows arrived sucked down in plastic, but once released they fluffed up nicely.  They have a white zippered cover on them.  While they are not super fluffy, they would not have been able to get into the shams if they were - besides these pillows are really just for looks so it all works for me.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful and I hope my review was helpful to you!
